text: {"name":"ipc_msg_receive","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Handle a received IPC message descriptor by clearing status flags, checking a table-selected data byte/bit, and scheduling kernel/MM/RF/BL events via ke_event_lock.","subsystem":"ipc","var_renames":{"result":"buffer","a3":"desc","v3":"desc_index","v4":"ipc_ctrl","v6":"flags","v8":"table_value","v9":"buffer","v10":"buffer_p4","v11":"field_val"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"descriptor status flags word; bits 0 and 1 are cleared/updated during handling"},{"offset":114,"meaning":"descriptor byte used as a simple conditional flag (possibly command/type related)"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"descriptor/table index byte used against a 696-byte-stride table"},{"offset":117,"meaning":"byte field supplying a selected bit position: >>3 gives byte offset, &7 gives bit"},{"offset":5,"meaning":"buffer byte used as the tested field/mask"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"buffer byte used in a range/limit calculation"},{"offset":5,"meaning":"buffer byte containing the bit selected by the table value"}]}
